module: Glow effect. Creates the separable blur shaders PFX_GlowBlurVertShader and PFX_GlowBlurHorzShader, the combine shader PFX_GlowCombineShader and the PostEffect "GlowPostFx" (rendered after GlowBin, resolution 0.5x0.5, reads #glowbuffer) to which three sub-effects are added: vertical blur, horizontal blur then combination with $backBuffer. No exported function.
notes: In the code, the "Vert" blur has BLUR_DIR=(0,1) and the "Horz" one BLUR_DIR=(1,0).
The local variable of the main PostEffect is named gammaPostFX (name inherited from a copy-paste) but the registered object is GlowPostFx.
